  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY ent 'Parsed Entity Value'>">
  %param;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY icon SYSTEM "icon.png" NDATA png>
]>

<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns/base" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/ns/sub" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment containing special chars: <>&"' and entity reference &ent; -->
  <sub:child xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.org">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block containing markup-like text: <root>&ent;</root>
    ]]>
    &ent;
  </sub:child>
  <?target processing instruction data with namespaces &ent;?>
</root>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ATTLIST item id ID #REQUIRED>
  <!ENTITY base-ent "BaseText">
  <!ENTITY complex-ent "&base-ent; ExtendedText">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <!ENTITY % ext-macro "<!ENTITY nested-ent 'NestedMacroText'>">
  %ext-macro;
]>
<?xml-meta version="1.0"?>
<catalog xmlns="urn:catalog:root" xmlns:data="urn:catalog:data">
  <!-- Top-level comment before items -->
  <data:item id="i1">
    <![CDATA[
      Unparsed CDATA section with &complex-ent; and <tags>.
    ]]>
    &complex-ent; &nested-ent;
  </data:item>
  <?catalog-action execute="true"?>
</catalog>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ATTLIST section code ID #IMPLIED>
  <!ENTITY e1 "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY e2 "&e1; Beta">
  <!ENTITY e3 "&e2; Gamma">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY info SYSTEM "info.txt" NDATA txt>
  <!ENTITY % p1 "<!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA | sub)*>">
  %p1;
  <!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>
]>
<?xml-app-context cache="false"?>
<document xmlns="http://doc.org/ns" xmlns:meta="http://doc.org/ns/meta">
  <!-- Comment: Testing deep entity expansion combined with CDATA -->
  <section code="s1">
    <meta:title>Document Title</meta:title>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA content: &e3; inside CDATA remains literal.
    ]]>
    Reference: &e3;
  </section>
  <?meta-action reload="always"?>
</document>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (product*)>
  <!ELEMENT product (#PCDATA)>
  <!ATTLIST product sku ID #REQUIRED>
  <!ENTITY desc "Standard Product Description">
  <!ENTITY promo "Special Offer! &desc;">
  <!NOTATION xml SYSTEM "text/xml">
  <!ENTITY extdoc SYSTEM "external.xml" NDATA xml>
  <!ENTITY % markup "<!ENTITY internal 'InternalMacro'>">
  %markup;
]>
<?xml-log level="debug" target="stdout"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/schema" xmlns:store="http://inventory.org/schema/store">
  <!-- Comment highlighting inventory items and namespace mixing -->
  <store:product sku="SKU001">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with entity &promo; and some symbols < > & ' "
    ]]>
    &promo; and &internal;
  </store:product>
  <?store-directive refresh="true"?>
</inventory>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY entA "ValueA">
  <!ENTITY entB "ValueB &entA;">
  <!ENTITY entC "ValueC &entB;">
  <!NOTATION html SYSTEM "text/html">
  <!ENTITY page SYSTEM "index.html" NDATA html>
  <!ENTITY % global-macros "<!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA | details)*><!ELEMENT details (#PCDATA)>">
  %global-macros;
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction test="true" mode="strict"?>
<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/ns" xmlns:v1="http://archive.org/ns/v1">
  <!-- Comment: Complex archive structure with multi-level entity references -->
  <v1:record>
    <v1:details>
      <![CDATA[
        <details>Nested markup in CDATA &entC;</details>
      ]]>
    </v1:details>
    &entC;
  </v1:record>
  <?v1-action cleanup="false"?>
</archive>
